title: Multi-Agent AI Architecture for Regulated Insurers: A generic AI framework under Solvency II and the AI Act in Austria and Germany
abstract: arXiv:2609.27636v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper proposes a formal multi-agent architecture for implementing enterprise AI in regulated insurance firms, integrating economic theory with institutional design. The framework synthesises three core theoretical perspectives: Arrow's risk pooling theory to formalise risk transformation under uncertainty, Nash equilibrium to model strategic interactions between decision agents, and Principal-Agent theory to address incentive alignment under information asymmetry. The insurer is modelled as a constrained optimisation entity operating under solvency, legal, ESG, and operational boundaries, with specific focus on the regulatory contexts of Austria and Germany. The architecture decomposes the firm into multiple specialised agents, each representing distinct functional domains such as capital management, underwriting, claims processing, compliance, fraud detection, and client interaction. translated_title: 面向受监管保险公司的多智能体AI架构：奥地利与德国偿付能力II（Solvency II）及人工智能法案下的通用AI框架
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一种用于在受监管保险公司中实施企业级AI的形式化多智能体架构，将经济理论与制度设计相融合。该框架综合了三个核心理论视角：阿罗（Arrow）的风险汇聚理论用于形式化不确定性下的风险转换，纳什均衡用于建模决策智能体之间的策略互动，委托-代理理论用于解决信息不对称下的激励一致性问题。保险公司被建模为在偿付能力、法律、ESG和运营边界约束下运行的优化实体，并特别聚焦于奥地利和德国的监管环境。该架构将保险公司分解为多个专业化智能体，每个智能体代表不同的职能领域，如资本管理、承保、理赔处理、合规、欺诈检测和客户互动。人机协同（human-in-the-loop）智能体通过……进行集成（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文提出一个融合阿罗风险汇聚理论、纳什均衡与委托-代理理论的多智能体AI架构，在奥地利和德国偿付能力II及欧盟AI法案的监管约束下，将保险公司分解为资本管理、承保、理赔、合规、欺诈检测等专业化智能体，并纳入人机协同机制。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a formal multi-agent AI architecture for regulated insurers that synthesises Arrow's risk pooling theory, Nash equilibrium, and Principal-Agent theory, decomposing the firm into specialised agents with human-in-the-loop integration under Solvency II and the AI Act in Austria and Germany.
